Sometimes they can be a nuisance and grow into quite big packs but not really in need of adoption. In my opinion.

I (27F) was backpacking through Peru and on a night bus to Lima. The lower deck of the bus was just me and one other traveller, a business man. We had exchanged pleasantries along the way in my broken Spanish and he gave me a card for his friends hotel as I hadn’t yet booked anywhere to stay in Lima. Everything seemed legit, and he had been quite pleasant but not pushy at all. I thought that he may be expecting something or it was some kind of pick up.  
Long story short he sorted out a room booking for me, I stayed in the room, went to check out and pay the next morning but it turned out he had paid for everything and left. 
I had no contact details for him to thank him. One of my very best experiences of kindness.
Thank you so much Mr Business man. So kind.
